title: Define proof-reuse effectiveness measurement
objective: Define a deterministic fail-closed measurement harness that proves exact-input proof reuse can suppress a redundant eligible execution, quantifies avoided execution count and lookup overhead, and leaves production validation/cache semantics unchanged.
non_goals: reuse T0 T3 or T4 evidence
persist reusable proofs in external storage
execute T3 assurance or T4 certification

required_invariants: measurement imports and uses the certified proof_reuse engine unchanged
first eligible request executes the supplied subject exactly once and issues a PASS proof
second identical request verifies exact-input reuse and suppresses the redundant subject execution
changed input policy implementation parameter or environment must force execution rather than reuse
T0 T3 T4 and forbidden subjects remain ineligible
effectiveness reports actual executor call counts and proof-evaluation elapsed time without inventing saved milliseconds
measurement uses only local deterministic data with no network paid service or larger runner
acceptance_criteria: two identical eligible requests have baseline executions=2 actual executions=1 avoided executions=1
the second identical request returns EXACT_INPUT_MATCH and does not call the executor
a changed bound input produces a miss and calls the executor
a FAIL proof is not reusable
reported avoided executions equal baseline minus actual executions
reported reuse hit rate and lookup timing are directly measured
no production validation tier or proof policy is modified

done_when: generic exact-match reuse measurably suppresses one redundant eligible executor call
misses and forbidden subjects remain fail-closed
measurement reports real call counts and lookup time
WU02 can qualify the measurement against a real reusable T1 subject without production cache integration
